environment.timing: closed-loop; nearest-rank percentiles per trial; no CI timing thresholds

comparison: before=historical fair baseline; wake/repeat=initial targeted notification; control=contemporary original fair implementation; final=targeted notification with drain subscriptions. Main runs sequential, not randomized A/B. Filesystem paired runs alternate executable order over three batches, each with warmup and three measured trials. Statistics are medians/ranges of trial statistics, not pooled percentiles.
